faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.q: Are the rates in EUR or FCFA?
items.a: Both. Our reference rates are in FCFA — 15,000 (Junior), 25,000 (Middle) and 40,000 (Senior) FCFA per hour. International clients are billed monthly packages in EUR: €1,500 (Starter), €3,000 (Populaire) and €4,500 (Premium) per part-time developer (80h/month). The rate you sign is the rate you pay — no hidden fees.

items.q: What's included in the Success Delivery Manager (SDM)?
items.a: Your SDM is your single point of contact. They handle daily coordination with your developers, sprint planning, weekly progress reports, escalation of blockers and quality gates. An SDM manages at most 5 projects at a time — service quality is capped by design.

items.q: How does the 72-hour replacement guarantee work?
items.a: If your assigned developer underperforms, leaves or becomes unavailable, we present a replacement profile within 72 hours. The replacement benefits from a paid knowledge-transfer overlap so your project never stalls. No negotiation, no extra invoice.

items.q: What tech stacks do your developers cover?
items.a: Our network covers React/Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, DevOps (Docker, AWS, CI/CD) and mobile development. Niche stacks are assessed during qualification — and we tell you honestly if we cannot staff them.

items.q: Is there a minimum contract duration?
items.a: No fixed minimum. Part-time contracts run month to month; most clients start with a 3-month engagement, which matches our sprint cadence. Full-time contracts include an exclusivity clause that protects delivery quality.

items.q: Can I start part-time and scale to full-time?
items.a: Yes — that is the standard path. Start part-time (80h/month) to validate the collaboration, then scale to full-time as your needs grow. Your developer, your SDM and your tooling stay identical.
